prompt: My daughter was born eleven days ago. My wife sends me a photograph every morning. I have forty one days remaining. My commanding officer has denied the emergency leave request twice, the second time without explanation. My wife says she is managing. I can hear in the way she says it that she is managing. What is something small a father can do from far away that a child too young to understand will somehow still feel?
